'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Chris Gogolen LS Coruscant: Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' That Yoda deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
